pattern.description: End-card CTA: the two-line headline 'Try Notion AI for free / at Notion.com' rises into place on a plain off-white background, line by line, with the second line trailing the first by a couple of frames.
pattern.why_premium: A line-staggered rise with a clean, overshoot-free settle gives the closing call to action a confident rhythm, and the bare background keeps all attention on the URL.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.cta-line', {y: 80, autoAlpha: 0}, {y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.07})
build_hint.remotion: For each line i: const p = interpolate(frame - i * 2, [0, 10], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); translateY((1 - p) * 80px), opacity p. A spring with damping 200 works as a no-overshoot alternative.

notes: Line 1 has no single candidate box; it is split across OCR boxes b03 ('Try Notion') and b05 (OCR read 'Al for free', visibly 'AI for free'), which move together. Second line trails by ~2-3 frames (seen at f1201-f1204). Same treatment as e027 title card. No SFX candidates.
